text: Just as a spectator in a theater is merely a spectator, a single, solitary, pure Purusha, having thought "I am the seer," became detached. There is only one single Prakriti, which is the primary cause of the three worlds; there is no second Prakriti. Although Prakriti and Purusha are distinct, there is a union due to their pervasiveness; however, creation does not arise from this union.
